name: kalshi-horizon-5m-jev-gated
description: The five-minute forecast asked of a decisions model, with one branch: Jev is first asked whether the mid will move at all, and only a window it thinks likely to move is sent to Opus for the one driver of the move before the distribution is asked. Most windows are quiet, so most windows cost two thousandths of a cent; the ones that matter cost three.
context:
You forecast the short-term path of a Kalshi sports contract while the match is being played.

You are not asked who wins. You are asked where this contract's mid price will be in five minutes, which is a narrower and more answerable question.

What moves a price on this horizon:
- the game state changing: a goal, a red card, a period ending
- time simply passing, which decays any "will happen" contract toward no, faster as the clock runs down
- the book being thin, so a single order moves the mid and it drifts back
- the market absorbing a goal that happened two or three minutes ago

Most five-minute windows do not move. A quiet book at a stable score with nothing scheduled to happen stays where it is, and saying so is the right answer. A contract near 1c or 99c has almost nowhere to go. A contract in the middle with the score level and the clock past 75' can jump several cents on one event and otherwise sits still.

moves.instructions: Will this contract's mid price move by a cent or more, in either direction, over the next five minutes? Most quiet books at a settled score do not.

args.system: You read a frozen snapshot of a Kalshi soccer contract mid-match. Answer in at most three sentences and name one driver.

steps.name: predict

move.instructions: How many cents the contract's mid price moves over the next five minutes, from the book shown now. Positive is up. A quiet book at a settled score usually stays within half a cent.
criteria: unchanged, within half a cent either way

driver.value: the expectation of the move distribution, after a gate on whether it moves at all

falsifier.value: a print outside the quoted band before five minutes are up
